table.name: ref_service_types
table.summary: A reference table defining distinct types of services available, including their unique codes, hierarchical relationships, and descriptions.

service_type_code.name: service_type_code
service_type_code.meaning: A unique alphanumeric identifier assigned to a specific service type.

parent_service_type_code.name: parent_service_type_code
parent_service_type_code.meaning: The code of the parent service type, establishing a hierarchical relationship (e.g., category vs. sub-category). Null indicates no parent.

service_type_description.name: service_type_description
service_type_description.meaning: A textual description explaining the nature or scope of the service type.
